NSCameraUsageDescription: King Speech uses the camera to film you in the Roles exercises and to help you stay in frame. The video stays on your phone.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: King Speech uses the microphone to record your speech in the exercises.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: King Speech uses speech recognition to check the words you say against the vocabulary.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: King Speech uses photo access to set your avatar.
